4 in 4 and rewriting the record books! The defending champions made a massive statement at the Women's Asian Champions Trophy, dismantling China 6-2 to register their biggest-ever win over them in tournament history! Fired up by Deepika's stunning hat-trick and strikes from Lalremsiami, Neha, and Sakshi, Team India keep their unbeaten run rolling in style!
